comment: themerms.lua "Water-surrounded vault": des.monster(nasty_undead[1], 2, 2) picks the vampire lord, a shapechanger, so makemon()'s first newcham() asks mon.c wiz_force_cham_form()'s "Change the vampire lady @ <x,y> into what?" under the wizard-mode monpolycontrol option, and C makes the vault's des.exclusion() and the rest of the level after the answer (ESC). A debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports to dlvl 12 and rebuilds it with #wizmakemap; the second rebuild makes the vault. The seed came from a JavaScript search over seeds 5330000-5330059 for this site; the date, character and inputs were chosen independently.
